verdict.rationale: Airwallex documents a Billing suite with subscription management. It supports multi-item subscriptions (e.g. a software license plus a support package) and multi-frequency schedules (annual upfront plus monthly fees), along with recurring invoices, so the core of recurring subscription billing with product-based plans is covered. The pack has no evidence for trials, mid-cycle upgrades/downgrades, or proration, which are explicit parts of the story. missing for 10: free trial support, plan upgrade/downgrade flows, proration logic, API-level subscription docs depth, independent or hands-on corroboration
